Traupman 165

aedificō, aedificāre, aedificāvī, aedificātum

verb, first conjugation

Other words

  • exstruō, exstruere, exstrūxī, exstrūctum — build, put up (a building)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Lewis & Short s.v. exstruō: to pile up, build; Traupman 165

Examples

  • Aedificēmus turrim.

    Let’s build a tower.composed

  • Theodōre, quid aedificās?

    Theo, what are you building?composed

See also builder, repair, demolish, build up, build on, assemble, make, put, join, take apart, tower, above.
